title: Epilepsy Fellowship
Department: Department of Neurology, Mayo Clinic School of Graduate Medical Education
Duration: 1 year (2-year option combined with the Clinical Neurophysiology EEG fellowship)
Deadline: January of the year preceding the start date
Eligibility: Enrolled in or completed an accredited adult or child neurology residency in the United States or Canada
International applicants: Open to international applicants; graduates of medical schools outside the US/Canada must hold ECFMG certification before appointment
Accreditation: ACGME-accredited; graduates eligible for ABPN epilepsy subspecialty certification
Application method: ERAS application with three letters of recommendation; appointment through the NRMP Match; interviews January–March
Funding: Salaried trainee position (stipend and benefits per Mayo Clinic School of GME)
Visa support: ECFMG J-1 and H-1B visa sponsorship will be considered (programme page)
Licence requirement: Fellows must obtain and maintain an appropriate medical licence while enrolled
Summary: A one-year ACGME epilepsy fellowship in Rochester providing advanced training in EEG, video-EEG, intracranial recordings and adult and paediatric epilepsy management with protected research time.

title: Vascular Neurology Fellowship
Department: Department of Neurology, Mayo Clinic School of Graduate Medical Education

Accreditation: ACGME-accredited

Positions: Page states two positions in one section and one position offered annually in another — confirm with programme
Funding: Salaried trainee position (stipend and benefits per Mayo Clinic School of GME)
Visa support: Mayo Clinic supports ECFMG J-1 and H-1B sponsorship (J-1 requires an ACGME-accredited/recognised programme; no new H-1B petitions requiring the US$100,000 payment); final visa type at Mayo's discretion
Licence requirement: Fellows must obtain and maintain an appropriate medical licence while enrolled
Summary: A one-year ACGME fellowship in Rochester training neurologists in the evaluation, diagnosis and management of stroke and all types of cerebrovascular disorders.
